scope: Read-only local converter/source/receipt audit; no remote operation, compilation, inference or new model conversion performed by this documentation task.

original_input.uncensored_evidence: Original configured folder and filename explicitly contain Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored; name is preserved as provenance, not independently authenticated publisher identity.
original_input.publisher_status: JonathanColetti is the recorded source folder namespace; no additional online publisher assertion is made.

tensor_contract.checked: shapes, formats, alignment and file extents; tensor payload not read

original_input.whole_file_sha256_status: Full source file SHA computed remotely during file-only publication; no model or GPU execution.

adopted_main.source_format: Mixed original Q4_K_M GGUF: eligible large main Q4_K/Q6_K matrices converted to type40 NVFP4; remaining tensors copied byteexact.
adopted_main.timing_scope: Historical main conversion only; excludes independent CPU head conversion and durable publication copy.

adopted_head.reason_separate: Main conversion deliberately retains original output.weight Q6_K. Qualified runtime selects this separate three-tensor NVFP4 head via STRATA_NVFP4_HEAD_FILE.
adopted_head.timing_scope: Historical old CPU head conversion receipt; the new parameterized tool was not executed.

publication.operation: Existing complete files published at actual L paths; destination bytes/SHA verified. Historical Y paths retained as symlinks without duplicate payload. Embedded GGUF metadata and tensors unchanged.
publication.external_rename_compatibility: Known cold-head validation checks embedded provenance strings and tensors, not the external main/head filename. Keep the current payload/header bytes unchanged.
publication.runtime_head_variable: STRATA_NVFP4_HEAD_FILE points to the published paired head. Model path is supplied by caller; user router/launch entry is not modified.

excluded_candidates: head-sf127 and head-sf127-abi: raw SSE improvement did not qualify native TG adoption; not the selected head.
EAGLE-4 external draft weights and negative GPU-round sources are unrelated to this converted model delivery.

algorithm.selection: main_layers=block_count-nextn_predict_layers; only 2-D blk.i tensors for i<main_layers, type12(Q4_K) or14(Q6_K), shape[1]>=256. Actual source65 total blocks includes1 nextN/MTP block; actual converted400 matrices.
algorithm.source_math: Decode true source Q4_K/Q6_K block payload into F32; this is lossy requantization from GGUF, not recovery of BF16 original weights.
algorithm.tensor_global: One F32 global scale per converted tensor = amax/(6*448), or1 for allzero.
algorithm.block_scale: Each16 elements: nearest positive finite E4M3 scale code0..126 around block amax/(6*global); evaluate center,center-1,center+1 in this order; choose strictly smaller actual decoded SSE, retain first on tie.
algorithm.values: E2M1 round-to-nearest-even, signedzero preserved by encoding; effective value=E2M1(code)*E4M3(block_scale)*F32(global).
algorithm.file_layout: GGUFv3 type40:64 values/36 bytes =4 E4M3 scales +32 packed E2M1 bytes; each8 low nibbles correspond to first8 values of a16block, high nibbles to final8. Separate tensorname.scale F32 scalar.
algorithm.head_math: CPU two-pass Q6_K output.weight conversion using the same rule, one global over all248320x5120 elements; source norm copied byteexact.
algorithm.not_enabled: No127-scale exhaustive search, no calibration, no new trained model, no new main/head generation in this cleanup.

new_parameterized_tools_status: New parameterized CLI statically peer-reviewed, not run on real model weights. Both main and independent head are mandatory outputs; backend selects only main CPU/GPU and head remains CPU. No automatic compile/model/inference.
